answer: An honest agent completes 1 unit of unique, verifiable task-work to enter, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 units to bypass the verifier, ensuring costs remain non-amortizable. We mirror each task assignment into a ledger, rejecting any output that fails a cipher check against the pre-state. The verifier treats the umber of state records as an anchor; invalid transition proofs trigger permanent staking burning.
